entries.subject: Bruce Van Natta
entries.summary: Diesel mechanic crushed by a 4.5-tonne truck axle in 2006 Wisconsin. Five major arteries severed. Reports seeing two angels with hands beneath the truck. Survives. Months later, his small intestine has tripled in length with no medical explanation.

entries.subject: Annabel Beam
entries.summary: Nine-year-old Texas girl with rare incurable digestive disorder (pseudo-obstruction motility disorder). Falls 30 feet straight down inside a hollow cottonwood tree. Unconscious for 5 hours during the rescue. Reports visiting heaven and meeting Jesus. Comes out uninjured — and her documented digestive disorder is gone. Specialist Dr. Samuel Nurko at Boston Children's confirms the inexplicable disappearance.

entries.subject: Don Piper
entries.summary: Texas pastor returning from a conference in January 1989. An eighteen-wheeler crosses the centerline head-on. Paramedics declare him dead at the scene — no pulse, no breathing, ninety minutes. Another pastor named Dick Onerecker stops at the wreckage, climbs into the crushed car, and prays over the body. Don begins to sing along with the hymn Dick prays.

entries.subject: Maximilian Kolbe
entries.summary: Auschwitz, July 1941. A prisoner escapes; the punishment is ten random men selected to die by starvation. The tenth man, Franciszek Gajowniczek, cries out for his wife and children. A Polish Franciscan priest steps forward — 'I am a Catholic priest, let me take his place.' The commander allows it. Two weeks later Kolbe is killed by lethal injection. Gajowniczek lives another fifty-three years and attends Kolbe's canonization in 1982.

entries.subject: The 33 Chilean Miners
entries.summary: San José Mine, Chile, August 2010. Thirty-three miners trapped seven hundred metres underground after a copper-and-gold mine collapse. José Henríquez emerges as the spiritual leader — leading twice-daily prayer for the sixty-nine days they wait. By the time the rescue capsule reaches them, all 33 are alive; 22 have committed their lives to faith. The world watches the rescue live.
